page: Microsoft Azure D4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running under Microsoft Hyper-V. The virtual machine provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. Cache resources include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It incorporates instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16), VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU, and integrates 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. There are no onboard graphics processing units.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-thread capability alongside balanced multi-thread throughput. In single-core testing, the instance achieved top-quartile results, recording 1987.0 on Geekbench single-core and 3079.47 on stress-ng. Multi-core performance aligns with expected midrange metrics for a 4-vCPU allocation, scoring 4447.0 in Geekbench and 6156.76 in stress-ng multi-core tests. Text processing benchmarks scored strongly at 2488.0, while static web serving throughput sustained 6.43 GB/sec. Conversely, memory-intensive routines revealed lower relative bandwidth, with uncached read operations measuring 37.93 GB/sec. This boundary impacted memory-bound and multi-core compile tasks, as reflected in lower-quartile scores for Clang software compilation, Redis SET operations at 5.92 million operations per second, and PassMark database operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bundled 236 GB local NVMe SSD provides fast temporary storage without requiring additional attached disk resources for scratch operations. However, the 4-vCPU and 16 GB memory footprint faces distinct processing limits under intensive parallel data transformations, medium-to-large language model inference, or heavy database indexing. Microsoft Azure D4ads_v6 is best matched for enterprise web serving, microservices, application backends, staging environments, and light transactional databases that benefit from high single-thread clock speed and localized high-speed temporary storage.
description: Microsoft Azure D4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. The configuration provides 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores, 16.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per vCPU), and 236 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage without an onboard GPU. It supports modern instruction sets including AVX-512 and SHA-NI. Benchmark metrics show top-tier single-core performance with a Geekbench score of 1987.0 and strong stress-ng single-core execution, accompanied by solid static web serving throughput of 6.43 GB/sec. However, lower memory bandwidth limits its performance on memory-bound database operations and multi-threaded compilation. Combining fast clock speeds with built-in high-speed local disk, the instance is suitable for web applications, API services, containerized workloads, and development pipelines.
